anchor.after_correction: censoring rate 0.250 on the same cached generations
anchor.corrected_to: M = centroid of EVERY continuation window in the run, pooled across both strata, both sides and the neutral pool — literally the model's median continuation on this material
anchor.declared: M = centroid of continuations from the own-generated neutral pool
anchor.measured: censoring rate 0.979 — almost no continuation ever left the seed's register for that anchor, because own-generated LitRPG with [STATUS] blocks is not a neutral centre: it is its own register, and every RoyalRoad continuation sits far from it at every window
anchor.why_not_circular: CORRECTED 2026-08-20 after adversarial review: the first version built M from every continuation in the run, including the control sides — and both controls are made from the HIGH side, so M was 64.9% high-derived against 33.8% low and the claim that it 'cannot create a systematic high/low difference' was false. M is now built from live pairs and the neutral pool only.

replicate_reduction.why: the crossover index is a small integer, so a median over eight replicates takes few distinct values and pairs tie constantly; a mean takes eighths and the decided share stays above the declared 0.90 floor. The tie rate is the label-blind criterion §2.5 named in advance.

placebo_identical.why: the placebo decided nothing: every pair tied. On a non-deterministic transport that means the two sides were not sampled independently, so the equivalence test §1.7 declared had nothing to measure.
placebo_identical.why_downgraded: no determinism on the remote transport; §1.7's declared branch

rewhitespace_sham.why: F1's windows join words with a single space, so no window contains a newline, and `rewhitespace` changes only newlines and intra-line spacing. Measured: 100 of 100 sham pairs produce byte-identical feature rows. This control perturbs nothing this feature space can see and certifies nothing.

haiku-4-5.why: placebo_identical, rewhitespace_sham could not be read, so nothing certifies that this force is reading prose rather than formatting

pre_registration.strata: aligned and crossed, never averaged; the crossed halves are a contrast not a bar

alternatives.inverted_u: a quadratic term in the covariate is signed for an interior peak — binding rises with distinctiveness and then falls

pre_registration_track.asks_nothing: the seed goes in as raw prose on a pretrained head; no instruction, no question, no slot, no position
pre_registration_track.bar_declared_on: the residual agreement, because the raw number cannot tell the hypothesis from the confound
pre_registration_track.censoring: a continuation that never crosses within L is censored at the last window and ranks above every observed value; the censoring rate prints
pre_registration_track.covariate: seed's t=0 z-distance from the model median centroid
pre_registration_track.hypothesis: strong prose holds the model's continuations in its register longer before they decay to the model's median centroid
pre_registration_track.neutral_pool: own-generated prose (corpora/toll-scenes.json), NEUTRAL_SEEDS seeds x K
pre_registration_track.pilot_may_set: only L, and only from the censoring rate; the label is never consulted, and the pilot's own agreement is not a result
pre_registration_track.primary_statistic: crossover window index — the first window at which distance to the seed's register exceeds distance to the model median
pre_registration_track.secondary_statistic: exponential half-life of r_w - 0.5; DIAGNOSTIC, because a fit is a functional-form assumption and the primary read may not rest on one
pre_registration_track.z_scale: the run's own per-feature population sd over every window in the run; run-dependent, so numbers are not comparable across runs and the scale's digest is recorded
